_about: Hand-checked meanings (design 3.3 rule 1). Every entry cites the local source it rests on. Entries keyed 'Name|H1234' settle one original word's flagged draft (a Strong's chain ending on an ordinary word, or a gloss too long for a headline); their wording is taken from Strong's own text along that chain, reviewed by hand in job 824 (2026-11-09); entries marked job 836 settle Strong's pointers the build cannot follow by rule (2026-11-09). Easton's Bible Dictionary (1897) is quoted from the CCEL copy already in SOURCES.md (easton-txt, sources/ccel/ebd2.txt).

Mary.label: Uncertain
